scope: Eight explicit keyword abilities, with exact reviewed Rosewater labels and frozen Atlas recipes. Not a universal mechanics detector.

records.detection_method: Scryfall keywords exact case-insensitive membership; card-level only, no inference of face or inherent possession
records.link_review_note: Exact label and scope reviewed in the frozen runtime; original explanation and per-color ownership retained.
records.blind_spot: kw: means the card has the ability. A card that grants it to another creature is found with Oracle text instead. CAL-006.
